## [1.26.11.05.1752](https://github.com/OrangeTree-Dev/Morphe-Patches/releases/tag/v1.26.11.05.1752) (2026-11-05)

patches.name: YouTube Music AI Tagger
patches.description: Adds a blue "AI" tag to songs by artists on the community AI-artist list (github.com/CennoxX/spotify-ai-blocker), in song rows, cards, the mini player and Now Playing.

patches.name: Shorts to Subscriptions
patches.description: Replaces the Shorts button in the bottom navigation bar with a Subscriptions button.

release_notes: * Stable release of the latest beta
